funnel: wall-capture — nothing fastens it; The silicone brim rests in the removable frame's roof surround. Its plug locates on the cradle snapped into the frame's web, with its sealing land on the elbow stem. The funnel lifts out by hand for the dishwasher, the land sliding off the stem.

fuse-clamp: gap-press — nothing fastens it; Both faces of the slot the clamp presses into are the compressor's own — the air its power box hangs over its mounting plate — so the clamp rides the can.
